description.name: Basic Attack: Gale Hammer Combo
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to 3 Strikes forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
During the 3rd attack, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer]</color>;
During the 3rd attack, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to directly activate <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Riding the Wind]</color>.

description.name: Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack]</color> After the 3rd hit, or when <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rising Wind]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Riding Wind]</color> ends without any <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>, automatically activates:
Delivers a powerful Strike downward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Basic Attack: Whirlwind Hammer
Dodge: Tailwind
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Perform a quick dodge to the side.

description.name: Dash Attack: Wind Chaser
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Headwind
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Wind Gather
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Rising Wind
EX Special Attack: Riding the Wind
description.desc:
With enough energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Roxy generates a tornado. Keep holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> and drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to control the tornado's movement direction. During this time, Energy is continuously consumed and <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> is dealt to enemies in its path.
The attack stops when Energy is depleted, or when <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> is released without dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}.
If <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> exists after stopping, automatically chains into <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon]</color>.
If <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> does not exist, automatically chains into <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer]</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the skill attack.

description.name: Eye of the Wind
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon]</color> Generated after consuming <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>, lasts 30 seconds;
When hit by <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Cyclone Hammer]</color>, it will be destroyed and generate a small tornado that continuously tracks enemies and deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
<color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> can be pulled by <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Cyclone Hammer]</color> and the charge phase of <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Cyclone Hammer]</color>;
When destroyed by any means, <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to nearby enemies.

description.name: Chain Attack: Storm Incoming
description.desc:
When a <color=#ffffff>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Storm Rampage
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Entry Skill
description.desc:
Triggered when switching to Roxy:
Launches a Strike at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>. Can be triggered once every 5s.

description.name: Quick Assist: Gale Cover
description.desc:
When the on-field character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Wind Wall
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Windbreak
description.desc:
After launching <color=#ffffff>[Defensive Assist]</color>, Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

1.name: Cinema I
1.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Eye of the Storm]</color> is detonated by any means, DMG dealt is increased by 10% and Daze is increased by 10%; when <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon]</color> hits, reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s.

2.name: Cinema II
2.desc: For each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> detonated, the next <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> deals 10% more Daze, up to a maximum of 30%. When switching out via <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color>, Roxy will maintain <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> for 0.5s without consuming Energy, up to a maximum of 1.5s. When <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rising Wind]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> hits an enemy, increases the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 20%.

4.name: Cinema 4
4.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Gale Combo Hammer]</color> hits an enemy, recover 2 Energy; when <color=#ffffff>[Dodge Counter: Headwind]</color>, <color=#ffffff>[Entry Skill]</color>, or <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer]</color> hits an enemy, recover 4 Energy; <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Storm Rampage]</color> DMG increases by 10%, and Daze increases by 10%.

6.name: Cinema 6
6.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Whirlwind Hammer]</color> detonates <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> to generate a large tornado, its duration increases by 2s; the large tornado continuously pulls in and detonates surrounding Wind Eyes. For each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> detonated, the duration is extended by 1s, up to a maximum extension of 0.1s; the large tornado's DMG Multiplier is increased by 150%, and its Daze is increased by 10%.
